title: Privacy notice
cookie_header: | Name | Purpose | Lifetime | Why no consent is needed |
processor_header: | Recipient | Task | Data passed on | Contract |
purpose_basket: Set when you put something in the basket. Remembers your basket until you order or it expires.
purpose_price_view: Set when you switch the price view. Remembers whether you are shown prices for private customers or for business customers.
purpose_unlock: Set when you enter the password of a protected page. N stands for the number of the protected page. Remembers that you have unlocked the page.
why_no_consent: Strictly necessary for what you asked for
cookies_some: Your browser only stores something when you do one of the things listed below. Such a cookie is strictly necessary for what you asked for, so it needs neither consent nor a cookie banner.
processor_hosting: | Hosting provider {fillin}, country of the server {fillin} | Running the server | Connection data as in the section Server log | Data processing agreement, where the server is run by a third party |
processor_payment: | Payrexx, payment provider, Switzerland, name and address {fillin} | Handling the online payment | Amount, currency, order number with the name of the website, name, e-mail address, street, postcode, town and country | Data processing agreement, date of the agreement {fillin} |
basis_eu_log: Server log: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. The legitimate interest is the operation and security of the website.
basis_eu_cookies: Cookies in the table above: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, and for the basket of an order Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR. Storing them in your browser is governed by the cookie rule at the end of this section.
basis_eu_orders: Orders: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (contract). Without these details an order cannot be carried out. For accounting records Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR (legal obligation to keep them) applies as well.
basis_eu_forms: Forms: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR where your enquiry concerns a contract, otherwise Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. The legitimate interest is answering your enquiry.
basis_eu_staff: Accounts in the admin area: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (employment or service relationship) and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. The legitimate interest is the security of the admin area.
basis_ch_log: Server log: operation and security of the website. The justification is the overriding private interest of the controller (Art. 31 para. 1 FADP).
basis_ch_cookies: Cookies in the table above: what you asked for. How you can refuse them is set out at the end of this section.
basis_ch_orders: Orders: concluding and performing the contract with you (Art. 31 para. 2 let. a FADP). Without these details an order cannot be carried out.
basis_ch_payment: Online payment: performing the contract with you (Art. 31 para. 2 let. a FADP).
basis_ch_staff: Accounts in the admin area: work on the website and protection of the admin area.
basis_uk_log: Server log: Art. 6(1)(f) UK GDPR. The legitimate interest is the operation and security of the website.
basis_uk_cookies: Cookies in the table above: Art. 6(1)(f) UK GDPR, and for the basket of an order Art. 6(1)(b) UK GDPR. Storing them in your browser is governed by the cookie rule at the end of this section.
basis_uk_orders: Orders: Art. 6(1)(b) UK GDPR (contract). Without these details an order cannot be carried out.
basis_uk_forms: Forms: Art. 6(1)(b) UK GDPR where your enquiry concerns a contract, otherwise Art. 6(1)(f) UK GDPR. The legitimate interest is answering your enquiry.
basis_uk_staff: Accounts in the admin area: Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) UK GDPR. The legitimate interest is the security of the admin area.
category_us_identifiers: Identifiers: the name and e-mail address you write into a form or into the opt-out form, and the accounts of the people who work on the website.
category_us_commercial: Commercial information: your orders with your address, the items and your choice of delivery and payment.
category_us_internet: Internet or other electronic network activity information: the lines of the server log, with a truncated IP address.
